plan.detail: SEARCH tasks USING INDEX idx_tasks_user_status (user_id=? AND status=?)

sql: select "id", "user_id", "title", "status", "priority", "created_at", "updated_at", "completed_at", "deleted_at", "attachment", "due_date" from "tasks" where ("tasks"."user_id" = ? and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null) -- [2]
select count(*) from "tasks" where ("tasks"."user_id" = ? and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."status" = ?) -- [2,"todo"]
select count(*) from "tasks" where ("tasks"."user_id" = ? and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."status" = ?) -- [2,"in-progress"]
select count(*) from "tasks" where ("tasks"."user_id" = ? and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "tasks"."status" = ?) -- [2,"done"]
select "status", count(*) from "tasks" where ("tasks"."user_id" = ? and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null) group by "tasks"."status" -- [2]
